steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F); line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Combine Ground flaxseed and Water in a small bowl; rest 5 minutes to gel.
Grate Zucchini coarsely, then squeeze firmly in a clean towel to remove excess water.
Flake Salmon into a large bowl, removing any bones.
Add Cooked lentils, Zucchini, Gluten-free breadcrumbs, minced Garlic, Fresh dill, Lemon juice, and Salt.
Add the flaxseed gel and mix until the mixture holds together when pressed.
Shape into 12 patties, each about 1.5 cm thick, and arrange on the prepared baking sheet.
Brush patties lightly with Olive oil on top.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until golden on top and cooked through.
Cool 5 minutes before serving; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days or freeze up to 1 month.
